promises.quote: KCC provided advice to bus operators using the A28 that they should consider not stopping in the vicinity of Nickel Cottages.
promises.summary: Advise bus operators to avoid stopping near Nickel Cottages

concerns.quote: The presence and position of the unmarked bus stop on the carriageway, where Mr Innes alighted from the bus may be considered a hazard. The bus stop is known locally but is absent any signage or warning to approaching vehicles. The evidence revealed at the Inquest was that this may have led to him being in a position of vulnerability at the side of the carriageway, where there is no footway available for use but only a small grass verge. In order to reach a footway to progress in either

The vegetation close to the area where buses stop includes substantial trees and hedgerows alongside the carriageway and the close proximity of this to the carriageway causes restriction for any pedestrian alighting from the bus to negotiate an appropriate place to stand on a busy rural road prior to attempting to cross a 50mph road
concerns.hazard: restricted pedestrian space due to vegetation

concerns.quote: the Highways Department at Kent County Council have completed work in respect of cutting back vegetation as part of a site review on the 31st October 2018, there is no clear responsibility for the management of the cutting of the vegetation and no clear indication of ownership of the land close to the bus stop as the Highway Authority did not concede any responsibility for the land adjoining the hard carriageway

links.explanation: Both reports highlight that hedgerows and trees growing too close to the carriageway create a safety hazard. The earlier report concerns driver safety due to lack of kerb/pavement, while the later report concerns pedestrian safety because the vegetation restricts standing space for bus passengers.
links.earlier_quote: The road is not bordered by any kerb or pavement but rather hedgerows and trees
links.later_quote: The vegetation close to the area where buses stop includes substantial trees and hedgerows alongside the carriageway
